title: WHAT IF YOU ONLY HAD 1,000 WORDS LEFT TO SPEAK? ⏳🤐 (Animated Short Film)
description:
The average human speaks roughly 16,000 words every single day. We waste them on empty complaints, road rage, and pointless arguments with strangers on the internet. But what if one morning... a digital counter appeared above your head, and it read: exactly 1,000 words for the rest of your life?

"Silence wasn't a prison. It was a mirror."

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 THE ULTIMATE COMMENT QUESTION:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
Be completely honest with yourself:
If your counter dropped down to just THREE WORDS right now...
Who would you spend them on, and what would those 3 words be?
👉 Option A: "I love you" ❤️
👉 Option B: "I forgive you" 🕊️

Tell us your final 3 words in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
